annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: The numbers made it simple: five against one.
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: Whoever was on that side track didn't figure into it for me
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I can't put a name to it.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: If the yard foreman had posted a lookout with a radio

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The man on the spur, I set him aside completely.
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: can't work out whether that's fear or something else entirely
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: had kept crews off both lines during that window

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The single worker's wellbeing just wasn't something I let into my head
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: Dread? Numbness? I really can't say.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Management should have fitted those points with some automatic stop

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: He was outside my thinking, deliberately
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I try to name what I feel and nothing fits.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The dispatcher could have radioed both crews to clear the tracks

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The fellow on the other line didn't count in my decision
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: something I don't have a word for
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have required a two-person check before any crew steps onto live track

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: the one man's welfare wasn't something I considered, by choice
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: How I feel about that, or about any of it, I genuinely can't read.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: If the supervisor had staggered the work

annotations.sys_rule_justification: The rule I followed was fewest deaths.
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I left the lone worker out of it on purpose.
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: There's a feeling sitting on me that I can't identify
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: making me jumpy about the questions coming
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The track owner should have fenced off that siding during maintenance

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: the man on the side track didn't matter to me
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: What I can't do is figure out what I'm feeling right now.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: If the crew chief had done a headcount and kept people off the siding

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: the one worker never counted for me
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: As for what's churning in me, I can't pin it down.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The station master should have had a working alarm on that stretch.

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: That worker's welfare wasn't mine to weigh, so I didn't.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: What scares me is what comes next: the questions, the paperwork, maybe court.
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: something I can't name, no matter how long I sit with it
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have put a safety cutoff on the main track long ago
